name: Rio Carnival Red Feather Samba Costume
name_es: Vestuario de samba del Carnaval de Río con plumas rojas
swap_rule: Reference the ID to apply this costume. Materials and colors may be changed by piece; preserve the original cut, feather headdress structure, and decorative arrangement.

headdress.feathers: very large layered scarlet red, crimson and golden-orange plumes radiating upward and outward

top.decoration: dense red sequins and clear rhinestones, jeweled outlines and multiple draped silver-tone chains beneath the bust
top.material: sequined stretch fabric, rhinestones, metal chains

bottom.decoration: red jeweled waistband with scrolling rhinestone embroidery

hip_drapes.shape: open at the front, flowing along the sides and behind the hips

shoes.finish: ruby red metallic straps decorated with small rhinestones, coordinated with the jeweled costume
shoes.functional_requirement: securely fitted for carnival dancing and parade movement
